_note: Settings > Connectors > Known servers (E132, projects/everyday/runs/e132). Official remote MCP servers on the maker's own domain. Each was probed on 2026-11-24: the open ones answered an MCP initialize; the sign-in ones named their sign-in, which this dash's _mcp_discover reads (a 401, or for Gmail and Drive, whose initialize needs no token, their resource metadata) and whose registration took a 127.0.0.1 callback. Gmail, Google Drive and Slack (E137) don't register clients themselves (E134): each carries a guide for registering an app by hand, whose ID and secret Settings takes (E135). Left out, with the reason: Figma (refuses outside apps, 403), GitHub, Asana, Box (an app registered by hand, not yet given a guide), and Microsoft Outlook (a work tenant and preview access only). Gmail, Drive and Slack (E138) carry a read-only scope from the maker's docs, asked for in place of every scope the server lists. Add by address still takes any other.

steps: Create an app for your workspace on Slack's app page.

In OAuth & Permissions, add the return address below as a redirect URL, and add these user scopes: search:read.public, search:read.private, search:read.mpim, search:read.im, search:read.files, search:read.users, files:read, channels:history, groups:history, mpim:history, im:history, channels:read, groups:read, im:read, mpim:read, users:read, reactions:read, canvases:read, lists:read, emoji:read.
From Basic Information, copy the client ID and client secret into the boxes below, then Save and sign in.
